summarization: The smartphone UI screen displays a promotional pop-up for a special deal or event. The pop-up features a cartoon illustration of two characters in a car, with the text "꿀라보레이션 딜" (Collaboration Deal) prominently displayed. Below the illustration, there are two buttons: one on the left labeled "오늘 보지 않기" (Don't show today) and one on the right labeled "닫기" (Close). The background of the screen shows a car listing with details such as the car model, mileage, and price, indicating that the main app is likely related to car sales or rentals. The top of the screen has a navigation bar with icons for home, search, and user profile.
